## Episode Thesis

This is an interview episode with Nicklas Storåkers, Avanza's first CEO and now an active growth investor through his family investment company. It mostly covers leadership, putting customers first, private versus listed markets, AI disruption and bubble risk, and the Swedish tax rules on incentive programmes. The market view is calm but cautious. He calls the macro backdrop shaky but not a crisis. He says he bought a basket of Nordic SaaS stocks in March, when they were about half their earlier price, and that it has done fairly well, but he could not name any of the holdings. He advises ordinary savers to stay out of unlisted investments.
